answer: For a walnut garden cooperative on a mesa, issue voting credits for nuts surrendered to a common processor. The processor weighs whole walnuts after subtracting packaging, then grinds them before signing a receipt for that mass. Validators grant one credit per kilogram and accept each receipt once across all keys, with no account bonus. Splitting a delivery cannot increase its mass; another credit requires surrendering another kilogram. Ground nuts cannot be resubmitted as whole nuts. Colluding processors can falsify weights, so their integrity is essential.
